12/13/2009: Station Maintenance:                                        [1215] 
 
            - Battery was replaced. 
 
 
 
09/26/2009: Station Maintenance:                                        [1030] 
 
            - Wireless modem was replaced to correct recent communication 
              failure. 
 
 
 
02/15/2009: Program Change: 
 
            - Updated MAWN program loaded on Arlene datalogger.  This 
              was done to reflect additional sensors that have been  
              installed on that station: 
 
               - mean hourly duff layer temp  (ctmp00ft) 
               - mean hourly 2-ft height temp (ctmp02ft) 
 
               - daily minimum duff layer temp              (ctmp00ft_min) 
               - time 'daily min duff layer temp' occurred  (ctmp00ft_mint) 
               - daily maximum duff layer temp              (ctmp00ft_max) 
               - time 'daily max duff layer temp' occurred  (ctmp00ft_maxt) 
 
               - daily minimum 2-ft height temp             (ctmp02ft_min) 
               - time 'daily min 2-ft height temp' occurred (ctmp02ft_mint) 
               - daily maximum 2-ft height temp             (ctmp02ft_max) 
               - time 'daily max 2-ft height temp' occurred (ctmp02ft_maxt)

              time period was corrected: 
 
                 12/04/07 (d=338) 00:05  -  08/15/08 (d=228) 00:07

              program corrects multiplier used to calculate wind 
              direction.
